papers.title: Full-bandwidth transformer
papers.what: Widens the narrow feedback channel between decoding steps by fusing the previous top-layer hidden state with the sampled token embedding through a gated linear unit; 1B-parameter models trained to 400B tokens match or approach standard transformers trained on roughly 1.5 times more tokens, with negligible decoding overhead and shorter reasoning traces.
papers.builds_on: PonderLM (2026, 3TLRP8U5); Latent Reasoning Survey (2025, EMXEJYHV); Attention Is All You Need (2017, PHB9VRVM)

papers.title: Massive Activations in Hybrid Linear Attention Large Language Models
papers.what: Measures where activation outliers concentrate in hybrid linear-attention stacks and finds two recurring shapes, pre-attention spikes and inter-spike plateaus, across five linear-attention architectures, six hybridization ratios, five data domains, and models from 1.2B to 397B parameters.
papers.builds_on: HARMamba (2024, HE9X47KN); Bi-Mamba+ (2024, AVTJLZIR); Attention Is All You Need (2017, PHB9VRVM)

papers.title: LycheeMemory V2: Efficient Long-Term Memory for LLM Agents
papers.what: Replaces per-turn memory consolidation with semantic segment-level consolidation into context-independent typed records; reaches 89.22 percent on LoCoMo and 92.20 percent on LongMemEval-S while cutting construction tokens by 86.0 and 75.9 percent against A-Mem, without raising query-time usage.

papers.title: Knowing When to Quit: Diagnosing and Training LLMs to Abort Futile Reasoning
papers.what: Names and measures futile reasoning on beyond-capability tasks, identifies specious reasoning as the dominant failure mode, and proposes CaRL, which shapes rewards to prefer refusal and converts observed failures into refusal supervision; ACL 2026 Findings.
